description: Delivery ETA contract: create DeliveryEtaService interface, CityBasedDeliveryEtaService implementation, bind in AppServiceProvider, inject into ProductController@show, and display an ETA badge on show.blade.php. Independent of FEAT-001/002/003 in terms of code — can be applied on top of any of them.
steps: Create app/Contracts/DeliveryEtaService.php: namespace App\Contracts; use App\Models\Address; interface DeliveryEtaService { /** Returns estimated delivery window in hours, or null if undeliverable/unknown. */ public function estimate(Address $buyerAddress, int $shopCityId): ?int; }. Note: the method signature accepts a $shopCityId int so the controller can pass $product->shop->psgc_city_municipality_id without loading the full shop relation again.

Create app/Services/Delivery/CityBasedDeliveryEtaService.php: namespace App\Services\Delivery; use App\Contracts\DeliveryEtaService; use App\Models\Address; class CityBasedDeliveryEtaService implements DeliveryEtaService { public function estimate(Address $buyerAddress, int $shopCityId): ?int { $buyerCityId = $buyerAddress->psgc_city_municipality_id; if ($buyerCityId === null) { return null; } if ($buyerCityId === $shopCityId) { return 4; } // same city: up to 4 hours return 24; // different city: next-day } }. Note: returns null when buyer has no city, 4 (hours) for same-city, 24 for cross-city.

Modify app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php @register(): Add import: use App\Contracts\DeliveryEtaService; use App\Services\Delivery\CityBasedDeliveryEtaService;. Add binding after the existing DeliveryFeeService binding: $this->app->bind(DeliveryEtaService::class, CityBasedDeliveryEtaService::class);

Modify app/Http/Controllers/Catalog/ProductController.php @show(): (a) Add constructor injection — add 'use App\Contracts\DeliveryEtaService;' import. Change signature to: public function __construct(private readonly DeliveryEtaService $etaService) {}. (b) In show(), after loading the product, resolve the buyer's default address: $etaHours = null; if (auth()->check()) { $defaultAddress = auth()->user()->addresses()->where('is_default', true)->first(); if ($defaultAddress && $product->shop->psgc_city_municipality_id) { $etaHours = $this->etaService->estimate($defaultAddress, (int) $product->shop->psgc_city_municipality_id); } }. (c) Pass $etaHours to view: return view('catalog.show', compact('product', 'related', 'etaHours'));

Modify resources/views/catalog/show.blade.php: After the price / compare_at_price block and before the description paragraph, add the ETA badge: @if(isset($etaHours) && $etaHours !== null)

🚚 Est. delivery: {{ $etaHours <= 4 ? '2–4 hours' : 'Next day' }}

@endif

Create tests/Feature/DeliveryEtaTest.php. Cover: (a) authenticated buyer with same-city default address sees 'Est. delivery: 2–4 hours' on show page; (b) buyer with different-city address sees 'Next day'; (c) buyer with no default address sees no ETA badge; (d) guest sees no ETA badge. Use RefreshDatabase, create PsgcCityMunicipality, Shop with psgc_city_municipality_id set, Address with matching/non-matching city.
acceptance_criteria: app/Contracts/DeliveryEtaService.php interface exists and is syntactically valid
Product show page displays '2–4 hours' ETA badge for same-city buyer
Product show page displays 'Next day' badge for different-city buyer
No ETA badge shown for guests or buyers without a default address
php artisan test passes with zero failures
findings: All 4 DeliveryEtaTest assertions pass. Route name in tests corrected from catalog.show to products.show (actual route name in routes/web.php). 4 pre-existing unrelated failures remain: ProfileCrudTest session hash test and 3 SellerProductManagementTest tests that require GD PHP extension not installed in this environment — both unrelated to FEAT-004.
